label: Benchmark — Report
description: Renders the standard shareable benchmark results video from a session's benchmark.json: machine-specs header, score / total-time / scenarios KPIs (stat-card), and a per-scenario render-time bar chart (bar-graph). Pair with the benchmark runner.

dir.label: Session folder
dir.description: Benchmark session folder to report on (the dir written by the benchmark runner). May also point directly at a benchmark.json.

introFrac.label: Animation length (× duration)
introFrac.description: Animation length as a fraction of the video duration. One slider drives both the KPI count-up and the bar growth (they're linked); the rest of the video holds.
